title: Sophaxis on X
text: Sophaxis has an official account on X, @SophaxisX, for new records and news. The handle ends in X because @Sophaxis was already taken; that account is not Sophaxis.

title: A call for an advisory board
text: Sophaxis has no editorial board or advisory body yet. The operator invites researchers in its fields to form an unpaid advisory board, which advises on the policies and decides no submission.

title: Name, logo and a badge for listed works
text: A page sets out the name, the logo and the colours, and a badge that authors of listed works can show. A page for anyone introducing Sophaxis gives a sentence, a paragraph and the facts.

title: Statements on funding, competing interests and research ethics
text: From 2026-11-24, the submission form asks for statements on funding, on competing interests, and on human participants and research ethics. The Moderation Policy now defines plagiarism and sets out how a concern of misconduct is handled.

title: Listed in the Open Access Directory
text: Sophaxis is listed under Philosophy and under Mathematics on the page of disciplinary repositories of the Open Access Directory, hosted at Simmons University.

title: The site in Japanese
text: The top page and every prose page are now also in Japanese. The records stay in English, as their titles and abstracts come from the DOI metadata.

title: Version 1.0.0 archived at Zenodo
text: The first version of Sophaxis, its code and its records, is archived at Zenodo with a DOI.

title: Listed in ROAR
text: Sophaxis passed editorial review and is listed in ROAR, the Registry of Open Access Repositories at the University of Southampton.

title: Sophaxis opens
text: Sophaxis, an overlay preprint server for philosophy and mathematics, opens at its address on Vercel.
